concepts.label: 1 — Classic terminal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square desktop application icon for TermRoost, a terminal manager for coding agents.
Primary request: a standard terminal window with a rooster. Create one polished, distinctive app icon.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent canvas outside the icon. The icon itself is a dark navy rounded-square terminal window, front-facing, nearly filling the square with an even safe margin. No external shadow.
Subject: a large, beautifully simplified cream rooster head and upper neck in proud side profile, with a vivid coral-red comb and wattle, small golden beak, and a single dark eye. Confident, friendly, restrained. The rooster is clearly inside the terminal screen and occupies most of the available screen area. A small bold mint-teal ">_" terminal prompt sits in the lower area of the screen, with comfortable separation from the rooster.
Terminal details: simple slightly lighter title bar, three small muted circular window controls, restrained thin rim. No stand or keyboard.
Style/medium: crisp flat vector-like graphic rendered as a high-quality bitmap, deliberate geometric curves and strong silhouette. Minimal, elegant desktop software identity, not a cartoon scene.
Color palette: dark navy #1a1b26 and #24283b from the application's Tokyo Night theme; cream white rooster, coral comb, warm golden beak and mint-teal prompt.
Composition/framing: centered single icon, square 1024 by 1024 composition. Substantial simple forms, balanced negative space, clean antialiased edges, readable at 32px. The icon fills about 88–92 percent of the canvas.
Text: only the terminal prompt ">_". No app name or other lettering.
Constraints: one icon only, genuine alpha transparency outside the terminal tile, opaque dark screen. No grid of variants, no presentation board, no background scenery, no photorealism, no 3D bevels, no gradients, no glow, no watermark.

concepts.label: 2 — Perched rooster
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square desktop app icon for TermRoost, a terminal manager.
Primary request: a proud little rooster perched on a standard terminal window, integrated into one compact app icon.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent canvas. A dark navy terminal window with softened square corners, a minimal top bar and a large mint-teal ">_" prompt on its dark screen. A small but bold full-body rooster stands perched on the upper edge of this terminal. The bird and terminal form one clear connected silhouette, fitting a square with even margins.
Subject: one full rooster in elegant side profile, cream body, vivid coral-red comb and wattle, golden beak, two or three broad sweeping teal tail feathers. Tiny simple legs visibly grip the top edge. The bird occupies roughly the upper half, the terminal the lower half; keep it bold and balanced. Rooster character is calm, capable, lightly playful.
Style/medium: exceptionally clean flat vector-like app identity, large simple shapes, smooth deliberate curves, strong contrast, no delicate feather detail, premium modern open-source desktop app.
Color palette: Tokyo Night navy #1a1b26, cream, coral red and mint-teal. Limited colors.
Composition/framing: centered square icon, one design only, fills about 88 percent of the canvas, good safe margin. Must still read at 32px.
Text: only ">_" in the terminal. No words.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency, no enclosing badge behind bird and terminal, no scenery, no keyboards, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no watermark, no variant sheet. The full rooster including tail is entirely inside the image.

concepts.label: 3 — Minimal geometric
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square desktop application icon for TermRoost, a terminal manager.
Primary request: a radically minimal rooster-and-terminal emblem, noticeably simpler than an illustrated mascot.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent canvas outside a compact dark navy rounded-square terminal tile. A narrow title bar with three tiny muted dots subtly establishes a terminal window.
Subject: in the center of the terminal screen, one large flat cream rooster head in side profile constructed from only a few bold geometric shapes. The rooster has a very distinctive three-lobed coral comb, a single simple golden triangular beak and one small dark eye. The neck ends in a thick horizontal mint cursor-like line, integrating the terminal idea into the rooster emblem itself. A tiny cream ">" chevron tucked naturally beside the neck adds a prompt cue without clutter.
Style/medium: minimal geometric logo, crisp flat vector-like graphic, extremely reduced form, confident visual identity, elegant balanced negative space. No feather texture, no decorative plumage, no large cartoon eye.
Color palette: dark navy #1a1b26, cream, coral red, small mint accent. Solid colors only.
Composition/framing: centered, nearly square, tile fills 88 percent of the canvas, rooster symbol large and clear. Must be easily recognizable at 24px. One icon, not a presentation.
Text: no app name or words.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency outside the dark tile. No background scenery, no gradients, no shadows, no gloss, no bevels, no outlines made from fine lines, no watermark, no multiple concepts.

concepts.label: 4 — Retro pixel
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square desktop app icon for TermRoost, a terminal manager.
Primary request: a charming retro pixel-art rooster inside a classic terminal window.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent canvas outside a dark navy terminal tile. The terminal is almost square with subtly stepped pixel corners and a simple darker title bar. Three tiny pixel squares suggest window controls.
Subject: one very bold rooster in side profile, full head and chest, built from deliberate chunky pixel blocks: cream plumage, coral-red comb and wattle, yellow beak, dark eye. A mint-green ">_" prompt at the lower corner of the terminal balances the rooster. The rooster is clearly recognizable at small sizes.
Style/medium: carefully designed genuine low-resolution pixel art enlarged cleanly, visible square pixel steps, crisp orthogonal edges, consistent pixel grid, nostalgic 1990s developer utility. Approximately 48x48 pixel design scaled to a large square canvas. No rounded vector strokes or blurry painterly shading.
Color palette: limited palette of Tokyo Night dark navy #1a1b26, lighter navy, cream, coral red, golden yellow and mint green. Flat solid colors, at most eight colors.
Composition/framing: one centered app icon, fills around 88 percent of canvas with even margins. Bold and readable at 32px, rooster dominant.
Text: only ">_". No words, letters, numbers or title.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency outside tile, one design only. No extra props, no countryside scene, no 3D voxels, no gradients, no glow, no drop shadow, no mockup, no presentation board, no watermark.
